---
name: Report an issue
about: Report a problem with quic-go.
---

Please read our [AI usage policy](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/blob/master/AI-POLICY.md#issues-pull-requests-and-security-disclosures).
Do not submit a wall of AI-generated text. We prefer a short description of the issue written by a human being. Imperfect English is fine.

Tell us in one sentence how you use quic-go, then briefly describe the issue and how it affects you. Include the details needed to reproduce it.
If you used AI, disclose which tool you used and how you used it.

For security disclosures, follow our [security policy](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
